note: States are judgments made by reading each project's own README and evidence documents. Timelines come from Git author dates on each repository's default branch. A first commit is when work entered Git, not when an idea began. The latest review is partial: entries with last_reviewed were checked on that date; other entries retain the 2026-09-27 snapshot. Project-local PASSED or SUPPORTED verdicts apply to their stated criteria and are not profile-ladder evidence of external or physical support. Same-seed reruns, and same-author repetitions on a new dataset, do not establish independent replication. tools/check_profile.py compares this file with every page that displays it on each push.

questions.confidence: When should a machine's confidence count?
questions.worlds: What happens when agents have to live somewhere?
questions.measurement: What would have to be measured?

states.CONCEIVED: Stated precisely, with at least one prediction or success condition. Not yet running.
states.BUILDING: Code or hardware design exists. Not yet runnable end to end by someone else.
states.EXECUTABLE: Someone else can run it from the repository.
states.OBSERVED: It produced a recorded result under stated conditions. The scope (synthetic, simulated, physical) is always named.
states.REPRODUCED: The result was regenerated independently: another person, another dataset, or another instrument.
states.SUPPORTED: The claim survived a test stated in advance, against external or physical evidence.
states.NOT SUPPORTED: The claim failed a test stated in advance. It stays on the record.

pre-registered Milestone 8: claim-relative evidence rules against blind comparators on 5,078 claims from five public datasets, with truth from held-out outcomes; frozen Milestone 3, 6 and 7 tests were also negative

experiments.open: The blind comparators were written by an AI agent of the same model family from a brief alone; isolation was instruction-based and self-reported.
